newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia peso ends 1.3 higher vs dlr at 1,058.70.
newsitem.headline: Colombia peso ends 1.3 higher vs dlr at 1,058.70.

text.p: BOGOTA, April 11 Reuter - Colombia's peso closed 1.3 pesos higher against the dollar at 1,058.70 in quiet trading on the interbank market, dealers said.
"There was very little volume and only a few trades," said one dealer, who stressed that dollar buyers were especially scarce in the pre-weekend trade.
Dealers reported 240 trades for a lackluster total of just $102 million and said the peso ranged between a high of 1,057.50 and a low of 1,060.00.
